name: nRF52840
description: Wireless MCU supporting Bluetooth LE and IEEE 802.15.4.

entries.name: VDD
entries.note: Power architecture subset; consult the complete pin table for board design.

pins.notes: Supply-pin subset only. Decoupling and RF pins are not external power outputs. QFN48 mapping; other packages require separate mappings. VDD and VDDH are connected inside QFN48; normal-voltage operation only.

radio.notes: PMU supply currents include the sleeping CPU and required clock/regulator resources. Do not add another base/sleep load to these states. CPU execution, firmware overhead, transitions, BLE 2M/coded current and timing remain uncharacterized.

simulation.scope: Explicit, mutually exclusive whole-device sleep/BLE 1M/IEEE 802.15.4 states at 3 V and 25 °C. CPU sleeps during radio activity. No packet generator or transition energy; QFN48 normal-voltage supply.
blockers: Automatic packet scheduling and startup/turnaround energy are not implemented.
Currents are fixed 3 V, 25 °C operating points; no voltage or temperature interpolation.
Concurrent CPU execution and additional peripherals require measured combined states.
